program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define all-pos
               (flatmap (lambda (r) (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range 0 (- w 1))))
                        (range 0 (- h 1))))
             (define squares
               (filter (lambda (rc)
                         (let ((r (first rc))
                               (c (second rc)))
                           (and
                             (= (at g r c) 2)
                             (= (at g (+ r 1) c) 2)
                             (= (at g r (+ c 1)) 2)
                             (= (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1)) 2))))
                       all-pos))
             (define (cheby-dist br bc sr sc)
               (let ((dr (max 0 (max (- sr br) (- br (+ sr 1)))))
                     (dc (max 0 (max (- sc bc) (- bc (+ sc 1))))))
                 (max dr dc)))
             (define (nearest-sq br bc)
               (reduce (lambda (best sq)
                         (let ((d (cheby-dist br bc (first sq) (second sq))))
                           (if (< d (first best)) (list d sq) best)))
                       (let ((sq (first squares)))
                         (list (cheby-dist br bc (first sq) (second sq)) sq))
                       (cdr squares)))
             (define (target br bc)
               (let* ((nb (nearest-sq br bc))
                      (sq (second nb))
                      (sr (first sq))
                      (sc (second sq))
                      (row-aligned (and (>= br sr) (<= br (+ sr 1))))
                      (col-aligned (and (>= bc sc) (<= bc (+ sc 1)))))
                 (cond
                   (row-aligned (if (< bc sc) (list br (- sc 1)) (list br (+ sc 2))))
                   (col-aligned (if (< br sr) (list (- sr 1) bc) (list (+ sr 2) bc)))
                   (else (list br bc)))))
             (define blues (find-color g 1))
             (define cleared (recolor-cells g blues 0))
             (reduce (lambda (gg b)
                       (let ((t (target (first b) (second b))))
                         (set-cell gg (first t) (second t) 1)))
                     cleared
                     blues)))))
